paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Average overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs across both KGDS patterns. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{avg} [61, 69]), Tier-2 (OP_{avg} [53, 56]), and Tier-3 (OP_{avg} [29, 37]).
model_annotation: The bar chart displays the average performance percentages of various large language models (LLMs) for knowledge-grounded discussion summarization, showcasing their overall performance across different tiers. The horizontal axis represents the different models, while the vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60 in increments of 20. The bars are colored differently and are not grouped or stacked, with each bar representing a single model's performance. The chart displays eleven bars with varying heights, with the tallest bar at 68.66%, the shortest at 29.44%, and others ranging between 36.62% and 65.77%, and a cluster of bars between 52.61% and 55.69%. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and some bars have similar heights, such as the group between 55.00% and 55.69%, while others stand out as being significantly taller, like the 68.66% and 66.41% bars, or shorter, like the 29.44% and 36.62% bars.

model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the average performance of various large language models in knowledge-grounded discussion summarization, with performance measured as a percentage. The horizontal axis contains categories representing different models or groups, while the vertical axis represents the average performance, labeled as "Average Performance (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, marked with tick labels at regular intervals of 10. There are nine bars in total, each representing a model or group, with distinct colors: green, purple, blue, brown, light blue, purple, yellow, gray, and pink. The green bar on the far left has a value of approximately 68.66, while the blue bar on the right has a value of approximately 36.62; the shortest bar, which is brown, has a value of 29.44. The chart visually arranges the bars in descending order of performance, with no apparent grouping or stacking. Notably, there is no explicit emphasis on any particular bar through shading, bolding, or outlining. The models appear to be stratified into three tiers based on their average performance: Tier-1 with an average performance between 61 and 69, Tier-2 with an average performance between 53 and 56, and Tier-3 with an average performance between 29 and 37.
